review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.notes: Native Codex queue replies have durable accepted relay receipts but bypass pane-send attribution. Join only canonical complete reply text against a replied HQ-target request, accepted receipt, exact Codex home/thread, and first matching source turn after creation. Header alone is a lookup hint, never authority. A receipt attributes at most one source record across newest/history pages; later copied text remains human. Use an append-safe bounded witness cache; rewrite/replacement or continuation-list changes invalidate. Historical accepted records need no migration; missing/ambiguous evidence stays unattributed. Both App/Web consume existing from.kind=hq; no client heuristics, no delivery/status/input permission change, no live session writes or release.

cases.description: Canonical first-prompt witnesses survive pagination and append, reject stale source identity
cases.setup: Synthetic Codex rollouts with same text before/after request time, duplicates, >300 turns, continuation files and partial/rewritten records
cases.action: Find first matching source records, repeat after append and replacement; cancel read
cases.expected: Only first exact prompt after lower bound matches. First record remains stable across append; rewrite/replacement/continuation changes invalidate. Complete lines only; no result bodies retained. Cancelled/error reads do not grant attribution.

cases.description: HQ relay attribution uses receipt and exact home/thread/body rather than pane or header
cases.setup: Synthetic relay ledger, accepted/replied/pending/refused/user-target records and human copies; source witnesses injected
cases.action: Stamp turns with correct/wrong identities, copied or modified bodies, old/new pane and preexisting from
cases.expected: Only accepted exact canonical HQ reply in correct Codex home/thread at its first source record gets from.kind=hq. Wrong identity, receipt state, body, missing clock/record or later human copy remains unattributed; existing sender preserved; no new sends or ledger writes.

cases.description: Read-only shared transcript contracts attribute native HQ replies in snapshots and history with receipt-aware validators
cases.setup: Synthetic Codex desktop transcript and durable relay receipt; own HOME/CODEX_HOME, no tmux/device
cases.action: Read snapshot, record acceptance without changing log, poll prior ETag, load earlier page and inspect JSON/ledger/policy
cases.expected: App/Web API turn JSON exposes identical HQ sender; new receipt invalidates prior human snapshot, unchanged snapshot is cacheable; old pages keep correct first-only attribution; policy/ledger/source unchanged by reads; CLI-origin and desktop-origin both work.
